policy_source: run reach-r5, checkpoint heron_reach_task.000400.cxpolicy, declared by the product agent as assets/reach_r5.cxpolicy (policy output heron_reach_policy)
spec_sha256_rule: sha256 of the evaluation report's spec block as canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces); the confirmation's spec must hash to this, which is the spec reach-r4's and reach-r5's round evaluations held

held_out_targets.rule: drawn from the accepted model before its first training run; every seed's drawn target A and B must equal the receipt's to within 0.001 mm, or that seed is void

conditions.goal: tip target A from 0.0 s, target B from 4.0 s, the held-out receipt's points

predicates.name: completes
predicates.rule: runs the full 8.0 s and ends by truncation; no termination fires

predicates.name: final_error
predicates.metric: largest tip-to-target distance over the last 1.0 s of each segment, in arm lengths (144 mm)

predicates.name: time_to_target
predicates.metric: time from the segment's start until the tip is within 0.05 arm lengths and stays there to the segment's end

predicates.name: overshoot
predicates.metric: furthest travel past the target along the segment-start-to-target line, as a ratio of its length

pass_rule: A policy passes a behaviour only if every one of the ten seeds passes every predicate. No per-seed rate is granted to any behaviour. One failed seed fails the policy; results are never averaged across seeds, and all ten are reported.
void_rule: a seed is void, and not a result, if its model digest is not the model read, it carries no policy digest, its drawn targets are not the held-out receipt's for that seed, its frames are not one per control step or the rate is under 50 Hz, or its episode raised a solver warning
verdict_rule: R2's confirmation passes only if the evaluation verdict is pass with every one of the ten seeds passing Q1-Q4 and none void, AND every judged seed (1101, 1105, 1110) meets the bar (median total >= 9 of 12, no trait median below 2). A judge call that is not a score (refusal, harness error, wrong model) is not a verdict: it is retried as a harness failure, not counted. Where the judge contradicts a measured predicate the predicate wins and the disagreement is recorded (ADR-463); a judged seed that misses the bar still fails the confirmation, and is diagnosed before any retraining.
commands: pixi run python docs/probes/ot11/runner/judge.py reach --evaluation ot11-heron-1/evaluations/r2-confirm-1 --seed S --label r2-confirm-1 --out docs/probes/ot11/retained/judge-r2-confirm-1-seed-S.json   (S = 1101, 1105, 1110)
film: detail sheet from 4.0 s (target B's onset), 0.2 s apart, which is the contract's reach detail; each frame shows the target marker
no_fishing: This confirmation is run once, and recorded in the iteration that runs it. A second R2 confirmation needs a recorded product change between the two.
earlier_evaluation: evaluations/13f9c63c93c9-6bb5a403c4af (reach-r5's training-round evaluation, a loop round, not a confirmation)
